title: CreatePipelineStepRequest
description: POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps body. `type` selects which per-subtype shape `config` must conform to. `position` is OPTIONAL (HEL-410; semantics updated HEL-904 for the trunk/tail step-tree model): an integer index (0-based) into the pipeline's current whole-pipeline execution order. Absent means trunk continuation — the step is spliced onto the current trunk-last step as its sole new child, with a persisted sibling-scoped `position` of `0` (NOT the old MAX(position)+1 whole-pipeline append value); present means the requested execution-order index is translated to a splice anchor, validated server-side as `0 <= position <= count` (count = the pipeline's current step count in execution order; `position = count` is equivalent to trunk continuation ONLY when the trunk-last step has no existing tails — `executionOrder` emits a node's tails immediately after that node and before its trunk continuation, so on a tail-bearing pipeline `position = count` anchors on the trunk-last step's last tail, not on trunk-last itself) — out-of-range values are rejected with 422 and nothing is persisted. `position` on the created/updated step in the response is always a sibling-scoped tiebreaker among children of the same parent, never a whole-pipeline ordering key. `enabled` is OPTIONAL (HEL-412): absent (or true) creates an enabled step; `false` creates a disabled step (excluded from runs, analyze, and preview).

parentStepId.description: HEL-906 cycle 7 (task 3.2): an explicit real persisted step id (must belong to this pipeline) to splice the new step in directly after, taking precedence over `position` when both are present. `position` can only ever express a whole-pipeline execution-order slot; `parentStepId` is the only way to anchor a splice directly at a specific node without recomputing its index. An id not belonging to this pipeline is rejected with 422 and nothing is persisted.
